variants.title: VSM of a ferromagnetic oxide thin film: Curie temperature
variants.sample: La0.7Sr0.3MnO3-type oxide film on a substrate, Tc near 360 K (SIMULATED)
variants.method: M-H loop at 300 K and M-T in 0.5 T from 300 to 380 K
variants.unknown: Curie temperature, coercive field, saturation moment
variants.note: A thin film carries a tiny moment on a large diamagnetic substrate (the negative background). Near Tc the mean-field m^2 against T is a line whose intercept is Tc. Tc about 360 K for LSMO quoted from memory - verify; the moment and background are illustrative.

source.title: A. Urushibara et al., Phys. Rev. B 51, 14103 (1995): La1-xSrxMnO3

variants.title: VSM of a paramagnetic salt: Curie law
variants.method: M-H at 2 K and M-T in 10 mT
variants.note: Cu2+ has one unpaired electron (S = 1/2); its powder-average g near 2.2 gives mu_eff = g sqrt(S(S + 1)) = 1.9 muB. g quoted from memory - verify.
